messages.subject: confidence interval
parts:
Hi, I have two qtls on ch1 at 75 and 348 cM respectively. When i try to calculate Confidence interval of first qtl, it takes the entire chromosome from 63 to 355 cM. I think it is not able to separate these two qtls. is there a way to separate them.
Thanks
Ajay

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] confidence interval
parts:
lodint() and bayesint(), for scanone() output, assume one QTL on a chromosome.

If you want to consider multiple QTL on a chromosome, it's probably best to fit a two-qtl model and derive confidence intervals from that.

Using makeqtl() to create a QTL object including your two QTLs.
Use refineqtl() to revise the QTL locations.
Pass the output of refineqtl() to lodint().

karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] confidence interval
parts:
qtl.index is a numeric index for the QTL. If there are 2 QTL then it should be 1 or 2.

lodint(refineqtl_results, qtl.index=1)
lodint(refineqtl_results, qtl.index=2)

karl
